description: The African development corridors database is a georeferenced database of 79 ongoing and planned investment corridors across Africa, synthesised from many sources and covering 184 infrastructure projects on railways, wet and dry ports, pipelines, airports, techno-cities and industrial parks. The interlinked tabular and spatial database has 22 attributes per project, with the source given for each observation, describing the types, scope and timing of investments. Coverage is continental, as of the 2021 build (geodatabase dated August 2021) published in 2022. It is free on Dryad under the CC0 1.0 public domain dedication, as an ESRI file geodatabase and an open GeoPackage in compressed files, and is described in a Nature Scientific Data article. Caveats: it includes only projects under the umbrella of an existing, in-progress or planned development corridor, not all infrastructure projects in Africa, and planned projects may change or be cancelled. The authors expect uses in strategic planning, vulnerability and risk assessment, impact assessment and monitoring; for simulation it gives future network links and nodes for scenario-based network flow, capacity planning and hazard exposure studies. It complements the African Transport Systems Database of existing networks.
